title: Ticket 1.61.10 — عملیات گروهی برنامهٔ غذایی (R10)
notes: R10 adds a manager-only bulk food operations tab for ordering/changing/cancelling meals and changing daily canteens. Closed order days are allowed; past dates and printed-group locks remain protected. Active local and domain staff with employee numbers are selectable without retrieving or sending national codes. No new database migration is required.
